claim: Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum is open Tue/Wed/Thu/Sat/Sun mornings only — 7:30–10:30 (Apr–Oct) or 8:00–11:00 (Nov–Mar) — and closed Mondays and Fridays; foreign-visitor entry is 25,000 VND.
quote: The Mausoleum is open in the morning of every Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Saturday and Sunday... closed to visitors in the afternoon or on Mondays and Fridays. Summer & Fall (April – October): 7:30 a.m – 10:30 a.m. Winter & Spring (November – March): 8:00 a.m – 11:00 a.m.

claim: Mausoleum complex shuts annually for ~2 months of maintenance and enforces a strict no-shorts, no-sleeveless dress code with silence inside.
quote: The mausoleum usually closes for annual maintenance for about two months each year

claim: Temple of Literature (Van Mieu) opens 08:00–17:00 daily with the ticket counter closing 30 minutes before, located at 58 Quoc Tu Giam.
quote: The Temple of Literature is open from 08:00-17:00. The ticket counter closes 30 minutes before the official closing time.

claim: Standard adult admission to the Temple of Literature is 70,000 VND with a 35,000 VND student rate (student card required).
quote: adults pay 70,000 VND and students pay 35,000 VND (with student cards required)

claim: The new Vietnam Military History Museum at Km6+500 Thang Long Boulevard, Tay Mo, Nam Tu Liem opened 1 Nov 2024; open Tue–Sun 08:00–11:30 and 13:30–16:30; closed Mon and Fri.
quote: Km6+500 Thang Long Boulevard, Tay Mo Ward, Nam Tu Liem District, Hanoi... operating from Tuesday to Sunday... closed on Mondays and Fridays.

claim: The new Military History Museum is ~15 km from Hoan Kiem Lake; budget around 4 hours (6 to see everything); entry 40,000 VND.
quote: approximately 15km from Hoan Kiem Lake—about 30 minutes by taxi... budget 'around four hours' for basic coverage, though six hours allows time to 'read and watch everything.' ... Entry costs 40,000 VNĐ

claim: Hoa Lo Prison (Maison Centrale, the so-called Hanoi Hilton) charges 50,000 VND adult entry and is open daily 08:00–17:00.
quote: Hanoi Hoa Lo Prison Guide: Ticket Price 50,000 VND, Opening Hours and History of Hilton Hanoi

claim: Hoa Lo runs evening 'Sacred Night' storytelling tours roughly Fri–Sun starting 19:00 (around 45–90 min) that visitors say outshine the daytime visit emotionally.
quote: the 45-minute night tour gives visitors the emotional feelings that the daytime one can't offer

claim: Imperial Citadel of Thang Long (UNESCO) charges 100,000 VND general admission with 50% off for students/elderly and free entry for children under 15; closed Mondays.
quote: A ticket costs 100,000 VND... Students with valid ID, elders and the disabled receive a 50% discount of 50,000 VND

claim: The Citadel is open 08:00–17:00 daily except Monday at 18–19C Hoang Dieu St; main highlights are the Doan Mon gate, Kinh Thien palace foundations, and the D67 wartime bunker.
quote: The citadel is open from 8:00 - 17:00 every day, except Mondays.

claim: Vietnam Museum of Ethnology opens Tue–Sun 08:30–17:30, closed Mondays and during Tet, with standard adult entry around 40,000 VND.
quote: open from 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM and is closed on Mondays as well as during the Lunar New Year (Tet) holiday. The standard entrance fee is approximately 40,000 VND

claim: Allow 3–4 hours at the Ethnology Museum to see both the indoor halls covering 54 ethnic groups and the outdoor architectural garden of full-scale traditional houses; it sits ~7 km west of the Old Quarter.
quote: Plan for at least 3-4 hours to explore both indoor and outdoor exhibits.

claim: Ngoc Son Temple on Hoan Kiem Lake costs 30,000 VND for foreigners with student rate around 15,000 VND; reached via the red Huc Bridge.
quote: Hanoi's Ngoc Son Temple Guide: Admission Fee 30,000 VND, Opening Hours

claim: Hoan Kiem Lake itself is free and accessible 24/7; in 2025 Ngoc Son introduced extended evening illumination hours until 21:00 Thursday–Sunday.
quote: the summer of 2025 introduces extended evening hours for Ngoc Son Temple (open until 9pm, Thursday through Sunday) with special illumination of the historic structures

claim: The Old Quarter's 36 historic guild streets (each named for a former trade, e.g. Hang Bac silver, Hang Gai silk) close to traffic and become a pedestrian zone Fri 19:00 through Sun midnight around Hoan Kiem Lake.
quote: Hanoi Walking Street runs as a free municipal weekend pedestrian zone from 7:00 PM Friday through Sunday midnight

claim: St Joseph's Cathedral (a neo-Gothic French-built church opened 1886) is free, with main gates open only around Mass; Sunday masses run 05:00, 07:00, 09:00, 11:00, 16:00, 18:00 and 20:00.
quote: Sunday: Morning: 5:00 AM, 7:00 AM, 9:00 AM, 11:00 AM; Evening: 4:00 PM, 6:00 PM, 8:00 PM

claim: Vietnam National Museum of Fine Arts at 66 Nguyen Thai Hoc opens Tue–Sun 08:30–17:00 (closed Mon) at 40,000 VND a ticket; a short walk from the Temple of Literature.
quote: operates from Tuesday to Sunday, with daily opening hours from 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM. The museum is closed every Monday... Entry to the museum costs 40,000 VND per ticket.

claim: Vietnamese Women's Museum is open 08:00–17:00 with 40,000 VND adult entry and an optional 40,000 VND audio guide; reviewers call it one of the city's most underrated cultural stops.
quote: The entrance fee is 40,000 VND for adults and 10,000 VND for children below 16... an audio tour is available for an extra 40,000 VND.

claim: Visitors consistently describe the Women's Museum as 'definitely worth a visit' and a 'great value afternoon', best done with the audio guide; allow 2–3 hours.
quote: Visitors describe it as 'a great value afternoon, which we highly recommend.' The museum is 'definitely worth a visit.'

claim: Long Bien Bridge (1899–1902, by Daydé & Pillé) is free, open 24/7, north of the Old Quarter, and best walked at sunrise or sunset for Red River views; bombed 14 times in 1967–1972.
quote: Long Bien Bridge was built between 1899 and 1902 by the French and designed by Daydé & Pillé... bombed 14 times, resulting in the destruction of several spans.

claim: Hanoi Opera House (1911, French-colonial neoclassical) offers interior tours only on Mon and Fri 10:30–12:00 priced at 120,000 VND (or 400,000 VND with art show); otherwise you need a performance ticket to see the inside.
quote: open for tours on Mondays and Fridays... 10:30 am to 12 pm... the Hanoi Opera House Tour costs VND120,000 per person, and the Hanoi Opera House Tour & Art Show is VND400,000 per person.
